instruction: A candid wide shot photograph captures an indoor motion capture studio with a dark red carpet and white walls. On the left side of the frame, the man in the black cap and blue shorts (R1) stands facing right. On the right, the woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) balances on her left leg, executing a side kick with her right foot contacting the man's thigh. The action is captured from a wide angle under bright, neutral overhead studio lights, casting soft shadows on the floor.
